mentions.name: Boutique Ad-Free Search Engine
mentions.description: A boutique search engine that downranks pages containing adverts to remove the incentive for creating spam, and that serves no adverts itself.
mentions.problem: Ad-funded pages incentivize spam and bias search results toward advertisers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Six years ago I launched a boutique search engine which downranks pages which contain adverts on them (the theory being that this would remove the incentive for creating spam) and of course contains no adverts itself
